features.title: Divine spellcaster
features.text: Your deity grants divine magic and additional spell choices. Doctrine shapes your approach: focused casting as a cloistered cleric or armored combat as a warpriest.

features.title: Divine font
features.text: Extra slots for heal or harm support your chosen role. Preparation can emphasize healing, protection or offensive magic; not every cleric plays as a healer.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2–3 → 2–4. Doctrine, deity spells, harm and offensive spell choices enable markedly different damage builds.
ratings.defense: 1–3 → 2–4.5. Cloistered clerics and armored warpriests differ substantially in personal defenses.
ratings.support: 4–5 → 4–5. Font healing and divine protections are exceptional; harm-focused choices shift the emphasis.
ratings.utility: 5 → 3–4. The divine list is useful but less broadly suited to exploration than arcane casting.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3. Prepare spells and manage font and focus resources; the core support loop is approachable.
